notes:
BrokerAdapter abstraction now has read-side helpers in production. Foundation for cTrader / DXTrade / TradeLocker that v1.0.27+ will build out.

### What changed for users

Behaviour is identical to v1.0.25 on a happy path. Under the hood, four new helpers route the highest-traffic MetaTrader reads through the BrokerAdapter abstraction:

- positions / open trades read
- live tick / bid+ask read
- symbol metadata read
- account info read

Each helper falls back to a direct MT5 call if the adapter init reverted, so happy-path behaviour is unchanged. Cumulative 41 of 113 mt5.* call sites now go through the abstraction.

### What's queued for v1.0.27

Order placement (mt5.order_send — 17 sites — REAL MONEY paths) deferred to v1.0.27 with dedicated live-MT5 verification, because each site needs intent classification (place market vs place limit vs modify SL/TP vs close vs cancel) and atomic per-site review before it ships.

Also queued: orders_get migration, history_deals_get migration, the History tab lower-section redesign (TT TRADES boxes have too much horizontal whitespace).

Once v1.0.27 lands the write side, the cTrader / DXTrade / TradeLocker adapters can plug in without touching engine call sites.
